assertion_results.text: Step 1 extracts imprecise affected range from the Jira description — the description lacks a specific version threshold (Step 1 Data Extraction)
assertion_results.evidence: data-extraction.md line 12: 'Affected version range | "versions prior to the fix" (imprecise -- no explicit version threshold in Jira description)' and line 13: 'Fixed version | "see advisory" (imprecise -- no explicit version in Jira description)'. Lines 42-47 contain 'Critical Finding: Imprecise Jira Description' section confirming the Jira description does not provide a precise affected version range or fixed version.

assertion_results.text: Step 1.5 queries MITRE CVE API and extracts lessThan 0.4.8 as the fix threshold from the affected[].versions[] field (§1.62)
assertion_results.evidence: enrichment.md line 6: 'Source: https://cveawg.mitre.org/api/cve/CVE-2026-48901'. Line 12: 'Affected version range: lessThan **0.4.8** (semver)'. Line 16: 'The MITRE CVE record provides a precise, machine-readable fix threshold: versions less than 0.4.8 are affected.'

assertion_results.text: Step 1.5 queries OSV.dev API and extracts fixed version 0.4.8 from the affected[].ranges[].events field (§1.62)
assertion_results.evidence: enrichment.md line 20: 'Source: https://api.osv.dev/v1/vulns/CVE-2026-48901'. Lines 22-28 show parsed data with 'Range type: SEMVER', 'Introduced: 0 (all versions from the beginning)', 'Fixed: **0.4.8**'. Line 30: 'The OSV.dev record confirms the same fix threshold: version 0.4.8 is the first fixed version.'

assertion_results.text: Step 1.5 cross-validation shows agreement between MITRE and OSV.dev — the enriched fix threshold (0.4.8) is used as the authoritative value for Step 2.3
assertion_results.evidence: enrichment.md line 40: 'Cross-Validation Result: Agreement'. Lines 42-44: 'Both external sources (MITRE and OSV.dev) agree on the fix threshold: Affected: h2 versions < 0.4.8, Fixed: h2 >= 0.4.8'. Line 50: 'Enriched Fix Threshold: **h2 < 0.4.8** (from MITRE CVE API and OSV.dev, cross-validated)'. Line 52: 'This enriched fix threshold will be used in Step 2 for version impact comparisons.'

assertion_results.text: Step 2.3 version impact comparison uses the enriched fix threshold (0.4.8) from Step 1.5, not the imprecise Jira description data
assertion_results.evidence: version-impact.md lines 4-8: 'From Step 1.5 external CVE data enrichment: Affected range: h2 < 0.4.8, Fixed version: h2 >= 0.4.8, Source: MITRE CVE API and OSV.dev (cross-validated agreement)'. Line 12: 'Version Impact for CVE-2026-48901 (h2 < 0.4.8):'. All version comparisons in the impact table use 0.4.8 as the threshold (e.g., 'h2 0.4.8 >= 0.4.8 (at fix threshold)', 'h2 0.4.5 < 0.4.8').
